ruleDefinitions.name: Hiding User Account Via SpecialAccounts Registry Key - CommandLine
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects changes to the registry key "HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon\SpecialAccounts\Userlist" where the value is set to "0" in order to hide user account from being listed on the logon screen.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\reg\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ NT\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Winlogon\\\\SpecialAccounts\\\\UserList.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*add.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/v.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/d\\ 0.*")))
